facts.fact: The Word of the Day for June 27, 2022, was 'jingoism'.
'Jingoism' originated during the Russo-Turkish War of 1877-1878.
The term 'jingoism' describes an attitude of extreme patriotism and aggressive foreign policy.

result.summary: On June 27, 2022, Merriam-Webster's Word of the Day was 'jingoism', a term that originated during the Russo-Turkish War and refers to extreme patriotism and aggressive foreign policy.
